entry.reasons: The entry accurately represents the formula for the change in electric potential energy of an object-field system as described in Topic 10.7 (10.7.A.1). The caution correctly highlights the distinction between the energy of the system versus the charge alone, which is a common point of emphasis on AP Physics exams.

The formula and caution agree with 10.7.A.1, which describes the change in electric potential energy of the “object-field system” when a charged object moves between different potentials. However, 10.5.A.3 already defines electric potential difference as “the change in electric potential energy per unit charge” when a test charge moves between two points. That requires the same relationship, so 10.5 is the first topic requiring it and should be included in topic_codes.

The formula and caution agree with 10.7.A.1, which describes the change in electric potential energy of the “object-field system” when a charged object moves between locations of different potential. However, 10.5.A.3 already requires the same relationship: potential difference is “the change in electric potential energy per unit charge.” Topic 10.5 therefore precedes 10.7 as a topic using this relationship and is missing from topic_codes.
